highlights_headline: SkiaSharp 4.158 introduces Skia m158, with subsequent collected updates improving GPU correctness and expanding HarfBuzz script constants.
highlights_body: Preview 1 preserves the managed API surface and co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.300 with native HarfBuzz 14.4.0. Later collected changes upgrade HarfBuzz to 15.0.0, add 30 named scripts, and correct clipping, text-atlas sampling and reflected hairlines. Those later changes are not part of Preview 1.

bullets.detail: Updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158 without changing managed wrappers or C bridge declarations. Preview 1 pairs it with HarfBuzzSharp package revision 14.4.0.300, not a native HarfBuzz upgrade.

Collected after Preview 1, the HarfBuzz update moves the native engine and package version to 15.0.0 while retaining assembly version 1.0.0.0. Removal of the unused internal font-face setter import does not remove a public managed member.

The later HarfBuzz update adds Script fields including Jurchen, ProtoCuneiform and Seal, plus 27 previously omitted constants. It preserves the existing struct API, field values, parsing and numeric conversions.

Corrects reflected zero-length hairline caps and Ganesh text-atlas sampler selection. Graphite bounds clip recording per render pass, rejecting and logging a draw whose clips cannot fit a fresh pass instead of overflowing its structures.

A post-preview update adds a 1 ms delay on relevant Ganesh and Graphite device-loss teardown paths for ARM proprietary driver versions 42 through versions below 56. Ordinary successful submissions are not delayed by this workaround.

preview_summaries.v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2: Preview 1 introduced Skia m158 without changing the managed API surface. It co-shipped HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.300 with native HarfBuzz still at 14.4.0; the HarfBuzz 15 update and later GPU fixes were not included.

harfbuzz_summary: Preview 1 co-ships HarfBuzzSharp 14.4.0.300 with native HarfBuzz 14.4.0 and no public API diff. The later collected HarfBuzz update advances the engine and packages to 15.0.0 and adds 30 named Script fields while preserving existing values and the struct-based API.

v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.headline: SkiaSharp 4.158.0 Preview 1 updates the bundled renderer to Skia m158.
v4.158.0-preview.1.26556.2.body: The managed API surface is unchanged. HarfBuzzSharp packages move to revision 14.4.0.300 while the bundled HarfBuzz engine stays at 14.4.0.
